places.name: George Town UNESCO Heritage Area
places.ai_summary: A historic area showcasing colonial architecture, cultural landmarks, and vibrant street art, recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

opening_hours.notes: Public areas are accessible at all times.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes to explore the area fully.
places.address: George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Penang Hill
places.ai_summary: A hill resort offering panoramic views, cool weather, and attractions like The Habitat and David Brown’s Restaurant.
places.place_tip: Take the funicular train for a scenic ride.
places.address: Penang Hill, Air Itam, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Kek Lok Si Temple
places.ai_summary: One of Southeast Asia’s largest Buddhist temples, featuring a towering statue of the Goddess of Mercy and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Extended hours during Chinese New Year.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the cable car ride to the top.
places.address: Air Itam, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion
places.ai_summary: A historic blue mansion showcasing Chinese architecture and heritage, offering guided tours and boutique stays.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available at specific times.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour to learn about its history.
places.address: 14 Leith Street, George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Penang Street Art
places.ai_summary: Famous for its vibrant street art, this open-air gallery showcases murals and installations by local and international artists.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; take your time to find all the murals.

places.place_tip: Join a street art tour for insider knowledge and access to hidden artworks.
places.address: George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Clan Jetties of Penang
places.ai_summary: A unique waterfront settlement with stilt houses and a rich history, offering a glimpse into the lives of Penang's early Chinese immigrants.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the privacy of residents; avoid visiting during meal times.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and culture of the clans.
places.address: George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Penang Peranakan Mansion
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the rich cultural heritage of the Peranakan people, with exhibits on clothing, jewelry, and household items.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed explanations of the exhibits.
places.address: 29 Church Street, George Town, Penang, Malaysia

attribution.description: The Pinang Peranakan Mansion (Malay: Rumah Agam Peranakan Pulau Pinang) in George Town, Penang, Malaysia, is a museum dedicated to Penang's Peranakan heritage. places.name: Fort Cornwallis
places.ai_summary: A historical fort with well-preserved colonial architecture, offering insights into Penang's strategic maritime past.
places.place_tip: Explore the museum and enjoy the sea view from the ramparts.
places.address: Lebuh Pantai, George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Pinang Peranakan Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history and culture of the Peranakan people, featuring antique furniture, costumes, and artifacts.
places.place_tip: Take your time to explore the intricate details of the exhibits.
places.address: 29 Church Street, George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.ai_summary: A butterfly sanctuary and insect museum, featuring a wide variety of butterflies, insects, and educational exhibits.
places.place_tip: Visit the butterfly farm first, then explore the insect museum.
places.address: 830 Jalan Teluk Bahang, 11050 George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Batu Ferringhi Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach destination known for its soft sandy beach, water sports, and vibrant night market.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food at the night market.

places.ai_summary: A lush garden featuring a wide variety of plants, trees, and flowers, offering a peaceful retreat and educational exhibits.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the different plant species.

places.ai_summary: A protected area showcasing Malaysia's natural beauty, with rainforests, mangroves, and coral reefs, offering various eco-tourism activities.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothing and shoes; bring water and snacks.
places.address: Jalan Hassan Abas, 11050 George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Wat Chaiyamangalaram Temple
places.ai_summary: A Buddhist temple known for its impressive reclining Buddha statue and beautiful Thai-style architecture.
places.place_tip: Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering the temple.
places.address: 153, Jalan Burma, 10050 George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Khoo Kongsi Clan House
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of Chinese clan architecture, this heritage site features intricate carvings, a grand hall, and a small museum.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the Khoo family's history and the clan's role in Penang's development.
places.address: 18, Lebuh Aceh, 11000 George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Penang 3D Trick Art Museum
places.ai_summary: An interactive museum featuring 3D art installations and optical illusions, offering a fun and unique experience for visitors.
places.place_tip: Take creative photos with the 3D artworks; be prepared to spend time finding the best angles.
places.address: 10, Lebuh Penang, 10200 George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Upside Down Museum
places.ai_summary: A unique museum where everything is designed to be viewed upside down, creating a fun and disorienting experience.
places.place_tip: Have fun taking photos and exploring the creatively designed rooms.
places.address: 49, Lebuh Penang, 10200 George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.name: Little India Penang
places.ai_summary: A vibrant neighborhood known for its Indian cultural heritage, with colorful buildings, shops, and delicious Indian cuisine.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; visit the various shops and eateries.

places.place_tip: Try the biryani and other Indian delicacies at the local restaurants.
places.address: George Town, Penang, Malaysia

places.ai_summary: A scenic waterfront area with wooden jetty houses, offering a glimpse into the lives of Penang's fishing community.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the privacy of residents; avoid visiting during meal times.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the sea breeze and watch the fishermen at work.
